bots.title: Bots
bots.description: Board members for agents and scripts. Each acts only on this board, through its own API tokens.

bots.readWriteDescription: Changes this board as the bot, within its role
bots.onlyOnceDescription: Store it somewhere safe. Anyone with it can use this board as {name}.

team.description: Team members for agents and scripts. Each acts on every board of this team, including new ones, through its own API tokens.
team.readOnlyDescription: Looks at this team's boards only
team.readWriteDescription: Changes this team's boards as the bot, within its role
team.onlyOnceDescription: Store it somewhere safe. Anyone with it can use this team's boards as {name}.

bots.runDescription: Builds the commands that set up a runner on your machine.

inbox.title: Inbox

boardSettings.title: Board settings
boardSettings.teamDescription: The team this board belongs to. It is fixed when the board is created.

items.tags: Labels people put on cards to sort and filter them.
items.fields: Extra values on every card: text, numbers, dates, choices, checkboxes or links.
items.columnGroups: Named sets of columns that narrow the board view.
items.assigneeGroups: Shortcuts that assign several people at once.
items.templates: Ready-made cards to start from, and recurring cards.
items.buttons: One-click actions on cards or on the whole board.
items.background: Background picture or colour and the board's accent colour.
items.automations: Time-based actions, such as archiving finished cards after some days.
items.rules: When something happens to a card, do something else automatically.
items.agentRules: Instructions an AI agent follows when cards change.
items.members: Who can see and change this board, and their roles.
items.bots: Board users for scripts and AI agents, with their own API tokens.
items.webhooks: Send board activity to other services.
items.matrix: Discuss cards in a Matrix room.
items.activity: Everything that happened on this board.
items.snoozed: Cards hidden until a later date.
items.archived: Cards taken off the board, still searchable.
items.copy: A new board with the same columns, tags and settings, with or without cards.
items.exportJson: Everything on the board, for backups or importing elsewhere.
items.tagNames: Off: cards show coloured bars instead of tag names. Applies to every board on this device.
items.groupNames: Off: column headers show coloured bars instead of column tag names. Applies to every board on this device.
items.archive: Makes the board read-only for everyone until an owner unarchives it.
items.delete: Deletes the board with all its cards. This cannot be undone.
